items: Complete the main quest The Crystal's Curse.
This is the first Wall of Memories curiosity and is awarded through the main story.
Complete the side quest The White-Winged Wonder.
This quest unlocks Ambrosia as a mount and adds the tack to Clive's room.
Complete Lines in the Sand and then Lines in the Sand II.
Both quests are tied to The Dalimil Inn and L'ubor.
Read Charon's missive at the Reading Table to unlock A Bone to Pick.
Finish A Bone to Pick, then complete More Than Words before departing for Origin.
Read the Payback missive at the Reading Table.
Complete the Payback side quest for Otto.
Complete Duty Undying and then Duty Undying II.
Both quests begin in Tabor.
Speak to Goetz in the Hideaway after Things Fall Apart.
Complete his side quest before advancing too far, since it can be temporarily locked by story progress.
Complete Trading Places and then Trading Places II.
Start the quest chain from Eloise in Boklad before Origin.
Complete the main quest The Flames of War.
This curiosity is awarded through the main scenario.
Complete For Great Justice and then For Great Justice II.
This is Quinten's signboard reward.
Complete The Fruits of Her Labors.
Talk to Comarc in the Hideaway to start the quest.
Complete Rekindling the Flame and then Rekindling the Flame II.
Both quests come from Martha at Martha's Rest.
Complete Tears of Mercy from Rodrigue in the Hideaway.
After the quest, speak to Tarja directly to trigger the Medicine Chest reward.
Complete On Balance in the Hideaway after Things Fall Apart.
Then complete Aiming High before departing for Origin.
Before Origin, speak to Joshua in the Hideaway and accept Where There's a Will.
Travel to Tabor, follow the investigation, and finish the quest.
Read Vivian's missive at the Reading Table before Origin.
Complete An Inconvenient Truth for Vivian.
Complete Where There's a Will first.
Then read Joshua's request at the Reading Table and complete Priceless.
Complete An Inconvenient Truth.
Afterward, read Harpocrates' missive at the Reading Table and complete the follow-up involving Dion.
Complete all seven base-game Chronolith Trials.
The Leviathan Chronolith from The Rising Tide is not required for the base-game Wall of Memories trophy.
Complete For Great Justice and For Great Justice II.
Then complete Smooth Like Butler and Three's a Company for Byron.
Complete Under New Management and then Under New Management II.
Both quests are tied to Isabelle in Northreach.
Complete Trial and Error from Nazaire in the Hideaway.
Then complete Silver Linings for Gav before Origin.
